title: Off-policy causal estimation in networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.02756v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the presence of interference, where the treatment assigned to one unit can affect the outcomes of others, many causal estimands depend on the treatment-assignment policy under which the experiment is conducted. This policy dependence creates a fundamental challenge for off-policy estimation, where the goal is to estimate causal quantities under a hypothetical intervention policy different from the one used to collect data. We study this problem of off-policy estimation of causal effects for heterogeneous Bernoulli policies. By representing exposure-weighted potential outcomes in the biased Fourier basis of the experimental design, we construct, for any prespecified Fourier subspace encoding the assumed interference structure, the unique minimum-$L^2$ weight that transports every function in that subspace. translated_title: 网络中的离线策略（异策略）因果估计
translated_abstract: 在存在干扰的情形下——即分配给某个单元的处理会影响其他单元的结果——许多因果估计量依赖于实验所采用的处理分配策略。这种对策略的依赖性给离线策略估计带来了根本性挑战，因为离线策略估计的目标是在与数据收集所用策略不同的假设干预策略下估计因果量。我们研究了针对异质伯努利策略的因果效应离线策略估计问题。通过在实验设计的有偏傅里叶基中表示暴露加权的潜在结果，我们针对任意预先指定的、用于编码所假设干扰结构的傅里叶子空间，构造出能够传输该子空间中所有函数的唯一最小-L²权重。全局与局部逆概率权重、线性干扰权重以及无干扰权重都是其特例。该权重（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文针对网络干扰情形下的异质伯努利策略，提出在实验设计的有偏傅里叶基中构造唯一的最小-L²权重来进行离线策略因果效应估计，并将全局/局部逆概率权重、线性干扰权重与无干扰权重统一为特例。
en_tdlr: The paper constructs unique minimum-L² weights in the biased Fourier basis of the experimental design to enable off-policy causal effect estimation under interference for heterogeneous Bernoulli policies, unifying global/local inverse-probability, linear-interference, and no-interference weights as special cases.
